ideas.pitch: An AML and supply chain risk detection platform mapping local logistics networks in the Midwest using graph intelligence and LightGBM.
ideas.title: Cincinnati Rust Belt Supply Chain Graph
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the winning pattern of combining complex graph intelligence with LightGBM seen in Bito, offering genuine hard engineering.

ideas.pitch: Poisson GAM and multinomial share model forecasting environmental and water incident anomalies with calibrated 90% prediction intervals.
ideas.title: Ohio River Basin Water Quality Forecasting
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly replicates the advanced statistical forecasting and incident prediction approach that won 1st place at the Apart Research AI Forecasting Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: AI-powered satellite monitoring platform tracking industrial land use changes and compliance across the Ohio manufacturing corridor.
ideas.title: Midwest Smart Manufacturing Satellite Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the runner-up GeoNex-ATLAS project by addressing industrial monitoring needs with localized spatial intelligence.

ideas.pitch: AI-powered patient acquisition and trust engine tailored for regional dental and prosthodontic clinics in underserved areas.
ideas.title: Appalachian Health Patient Trust & Acquisition Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies proven rapid-prototype healthcare trust acquisition patterns from Global-Smile into a focused regional domain.

ideas.pitch: Multi-agent student support platform combining LangGraph, RAG, and personalized AI agents to optimize university sustainability initiatives.
ideas.title: Campus GreenNovation Multi-Agent Support Hub
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the multi-agent LangGraph and RAG architecture that won 1st place at the GreenNovation Hackathon.
